code: (async()=>{const E=window.__echoes;const tk=n=>new Promise(res=>{const t0=E.tick;const iv=setInterval(()=>{if(E.tick>=t0+n){clearInterval(iv);res()}},4)});const mm=(x,y)=>window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{clientX:x,clientY:y}));const kd=c=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:c}));const ku=c=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:c}));const st=()=>E.state();async function aimAt(wx,wz){let sx=800,sy=450;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const probe=[[sx,sy],[sx+120,sy],[sx,sy-90]];const ws=[];for(const[px,py]of probe){mm(px,py);await tk(3);const a=st().party[0].aim;ws.push([a.x,a.z])}const ax=(ws[1][0]-ws[0][0])/120,bx=(ws[2][0]-ws[0][0])/(-90),az=(ws[1][1]-ws[0][1])/120,bz=(ws[2][1]-ws[0][1])/(-90);const det=ax*bz-bx*az;if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)break;const dx=wx-ws[0][0],dz=wz-ws[0][1];sx+=(dx*bz-bx*dz)/det;sy+=(ax*dz-dx*az)/det}mm(sx,sy);await tk(3);return st().party[0].aim}const log={};const P=st().party;const ids={0:P[0].id};for(const p of P.slice(1))ids[p.partyIndex]=p.id;E.cmd('teleport',2.6,-2.6);E.cmd('setHp',ids[1],0.5);await tk(50);log.aim=await aimAt(-1.9,-1.0);kd('Digit1');await tk(2);ku('Digit1');await tk(8);log.bolt=st().skillBolts;return log})()
